summary.text: Thomas Stalcup, a Republican Ph.D. physicist and entrepreneur who describes himself as a former Bernie Sanders supporter, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Massachusetts's 4th District to Jake Auchincloss.

paragraphs.text: Stalcup holds a Ph.D. in physics, according to his Ballotpedia survey responses, and his campaign website says he earlier conducted research at the National High Magnetic Field Laboratory.
He founded an environmental-monitoring company whose systems, he says, have been deployed from the Arctic to Antarctica.

BallotReady lists him as president of Upward Innovations, Inc. since 2004, and his campaign website describes him as president of an electronics company that designs and manufactures environmental monitoring systems.
Stalcup describes himself as an independent-minded Republican and says he previously supported Bernie Sanders.
He won the September 1, 2026 Republican primary for the seat with no opponent.
During the campaign, he ran on a "Science Over Politics" platform.
He received 33.6% of the vote to Jake Auchincloss's 66.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
